newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FOREKSPANK GETS POSITIVE COURT DECISION.
newsitem.headline: FOREKSPANK GETS POSITIVE COURT DECISION.

text.p: Forekspank said on Friday it had received a favourable decision from the St Petersburg city and Leningrad region arbitration court, overturning the St Petersburg tax police's order to freeze one of its accounts.
The court decided on Thursday to forbid the carrying out of the tax police's orders with regard to Forespank's correspondent account with Mezhkombank, the bank said in a statement.
"We have the court's decision and will we see during the day if the account has been freed," Ivar Lukk, Forekspank's board chairman, told Reuters.
The court also decided that the tax police does not have any right of appeal against the decision, the bank said.
The decision regarding the other Forekspank account held with the Promstroibank is due to be heard today.
The court case against the St Petersburg tax police's decision to freeze the accounts will be heard before the abitration court on September 16.
"We will be seeking damages from the tax police, but we have yet to calculate the amount," Lukk added.
